name: com.liminallabs.interaction
description: Genre-agnostic interaction: one core (interactables, verb assets, validation, hold-to-interact, request-handler seam) with pluggable detection per genre - ray (FPS), proximity (third person), pointer (point-and-click / CRPG) - and presentation as hooks, never baked in. Built on Liminal Labs Game Events for decoupled reactions; every rejection is answerable via the debug overlay.

samples.description: Same objects, four genres: Tab switches between FPS, third person, point-and-click, and CRPG rigs interacting with one set of interactables - a door, a lever that unlocks a chest and lights a lamp via GameEvents, a hold-to-pick-up gem, and an NPC. F3 opens the diagnostics overlay. Materials use URP.
